title: a worker whose listed subagent is not approved is rejected at launch (exit 2), naming the worker, the subagent and its status; a worker with no subagents is unaffected
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (a worker may launch only with approved subagents)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-11, approved subagents; docs/decisions.md). A subagent's prompt reaches `claude --agents`, so it is reviewed text: a worker may launch only with approved subagents. The overlay is a copy of the fixture's plan with its status set to candidate or retired (valid for the catalog). `launch --build sonnet-automator`, which lists plan, is rejected at launch, not at catalog load: exit 2, one stderr line `JITSO REJECTED: build "sonnet-automator" lists subagent "plan", which is <status>, not approved`, nothing on stdout, no registry line, orca never called. A worker that lists no subagent (haiku-explorer) still launches, so the catalog stays usable while one subagent is edited. The TS binary ignores a subagent's status, and also passes no --agents, so the first launch exits 0 and prints a card.

files.jitso/builds/plan.yaml:
# Subagent-tier build (tier: subagent): not launchable alone, a worker lists it by name in subagents.
id: plan
version: 1
status: {{status}}
tier: subagent
role: operator
type: planner
work_kind: planning
description: Read-only planner that turns one user story into an ordered list of automation steps and returns it without editing anything.
prompt: You are the planner of this session. Read the approved test plan and the code it touches, then return a short numbered list of the steps to automate, each naming the file it changes. Never edit, create or delete a file.
harness: claude
model: claude-haiku-5-5
effort: low
mode_default: direct
agents_md: exclude
route_scope: [none]
skills_first: []
tools: [Read, Glob, Grep]
mcp: []
requires: []
budget: { tokens: 100000, usd_list_cap: 0.50 }
success:
  - { check: answer_delivered }

stderr: JITSO REJECTED: build "sonnet-automator" lists subagent "plan", which is {{status}}, not approved
